### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 8/10" aria-label="Importance 8 of 10">8</span> SpaceX Crew-12 completes 237-day mission with record spacewalk achievement
SpaceX Crew-12 returned to Earth on October 8 after 237 days conducting lunar and Mars preparation research. The four-person crew splashed down in the Pacific off Los Angeles after completing 3,792 orbits and 100 million miles.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>237 days in orbit, splashed down October 8, 2026</li>
<li>Crew: Jessica Meir, Jack Hathaway, Sophie Adenot, Andrey Fedyaev</li>
<li>Completed 3,792 orbits, traveled 100+ million miles</li>
<li>Launched February 13, 2026; docked ISS February 14</li>
<li>Achieved record-setting spacewalk activity</li>
</ul>
